items.quote: At some point, following up feels less like relationship-building… and more like digital lurking. I’ve been there. And honestly? It’s not just uncomfortable — it’s ineffective.
items.statement: Following up feels less like relationship-building… and more like digital lurking.

items.quote: It means showing up strategically. With purpose. With clarity. With timing that makes sense for them, not just for you.
items.statement: Show up strategically, with purpose, clarity, and proper timing.

items.quote: That’s why I created a follow-up formula I still use to this day.
items.statement: I created a follow-up formula built on the goal to position yourself as the obvious next step.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing follow-up strategies in sales to avoid being intrusive.
